description: This file defines a class `Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage_Session` that manages user agent storage using PHP sessions, specifically within the Zend Framework. It provides methods for storing, retrieving, and clearing session data related to user agent information.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage_Session
classes.description: A class that implements the Zend_Http_UserAgent_Storage interface to store user agent data within PHP sessions, allowing configuration of namespace and member name for session storage.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the session storage object with optional configuration parameters, setting up the session namespace and member.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the session namespace name used by this storage.

methods.name: getMember
methods.description: Returns the session object member name.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the session storage is empty.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves the stored user agent data from the session.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores user agent data into the session.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the user agent data from the session.
